prompt: I want to show how our company's revenue breaks down by product line, then by region within each product line, over the last 4 quarters

assertions.text: Identifies this as a composition question with a time dimension
Recommends sunburst or treemap for the hierarchical breakdown
Addresses the temporal dimension separately (stacked bar, faceted view, or small multiples)
Discusses the tradeoff between hierarchy and time visualization
Provides at least one code example
